name: bramber
description: Compile many sources into versioned, point-of-view documents that cite their sources and resist being dominated by loud or irrelevant material. Point bramber at documents, notes, or code; define a view (what the document is for); bramber breaks each source into atomic units, selects the ones that fit the view, and compiles a living document with full lineage back to its evidence, served read-only over MCP. Run /bramber:init in a folder to get started.
